dialect.detail: Tandem/HPE NonStop COBOL (Guardian/OSS environment): ?CONSULT, ?SEARCH, ?NOLMAP, ?SAVE ALL, ?SAVEABEND, ?LINES, ?CHECK, ?SQL compiler directives are characteristic of Tandem NonStop COBOL (PATHWAY/ServerClass environment). Program uses PATHSEND, SERVERCLASS concepts.

purpose.domain_detail: Fleet card (Flottenkarten) authorization processing system converting terminal protocol messages (type 200) to AS-IFSF protocol (type 1200) for multiple fleet card authorization systems including Avia, Shell, Total, DKV, Eurowag, Stiglechner, LogPay, BP, ENI, Orlen, UTA, TND
purpose.summary: This program converts fleet card terminal authorization requests from terminal protocol to IFSF protocol for various fleet card authorization systems (AS). It handles MAC/PAC security processing, article mapping, chip card (EMV) processing, BIN blocking, and logging. It supports multiple routing targets (Avia, Shell, Total, DKV, Eurowag, etc.) identified by routing key (ROUTKZ).

notable_features: EXEC SQL (DB2-style embedded SQL via ?SQL directive)
Tandem NonStop COBOL compiler directives (?CONSULT, ?SEARCH, ?SAVE ALL, ?SAVEABEND)
PATHSEND for inter-process communication on NonStop
274 PERFORM statements with structured section layout
Extensive version history in comments (G.00.00 through G.04.05, 2015-2019)
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars but sufficient evidence present. Program is clearly a production Tandem NonStop COBOL application for a German/European fleet card payment processing system. The ?SEARCH directives reference named modules (=TALLIB, =ASC2EBC, etc.) typical of NonStop ENSCRIBE/Guardian library search paths. 'online-cics' program_type used as closest approximation to NonStop PATHWAY server class (no CICS, but server-based online transaction processing).
